summary: Iteration 12 media pipeline tested end-to-end. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_transcode.py — 11 tests covering WebP/AVIF negotiation, on-disk cache, 404 propagation, regression (leads, security headers, gzip) and admin upload contract (image vs video H.265). All 11 pass sequentially.

minor.issue: First uncached WebP encode of the 14.7MB sample takes ~30-35s over the public preview URL, causing ingress 502s when multiple parallel workers hit the same asset. Serial runs are fine and subsequent hits are cached (<200ms). Consider warming cache at boot or lowering Pillow AVIF/WebP effort for first-encode latency.

During the parallel run backend logged 'RuntimeError: No response returned.' from starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware when a client disconnected mid-transcode. Non-fatal (response already aborted) but worth switching to a pure ASGI middleware or catching ClientDisconnect.

action_items: Consider pre-warming the /app/backend/.media_cache/ for hot gallery assets on startup so first-time visitors don't pay the ~30s encode cost through the public ingress.
Harden apply_security_headers against client disconnects (or move to pure ASGI middleware) to eliminate the 'No response returned.' log noise seen under load.
critical_code_review_comments: media_transcoder.py is clean, well-scoped, has safe fallbacks, and correctly caches on disk keyed by sha1(path)+fmt.

server.py:733-770 buffers the entire image into memory before transcoding — acceptable for photos but do NOT let this branch be reached for very large PNGs; consider a max-buffer guard (e.g. 20MB) before entering the transcode branch.

_background_transcode_video is fire-and-forget with no persistence of failure state — if ffmpeg fails, the API still advertises h265_url that will 404 forever. Consider persisting h265_status somewhere or letting the frontend fall back gracefully (which it does per the note in the source).
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/passless-login (no body) — returns admin token; per /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Uploaded transient TEST_iter12.jpg + TEST_iter12.mp4 via /api/admin/upload; not cleaned up explicitly (small footprint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with `-n 0` (serial) because pytest.ini forces 2 xdist workers by default; parallel workers cause ingress 502s while the first WebP/AVIF encode of the 14.7MB sample runs (~30s). Cache under /app/backend/.media_cache/ is persistent so the second run is fast. Sample image path used: caremanto/uploads/1448ad41014747fbbc8eefce7abe2fe5.jpg. Video test spins up a 1s libx264 mp4 via ffmpeg lavfi.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bugs. The one apparent regression in the earlier parallel run (502s + 'No response returned' middleware error) was tracked to (a) ingress read timeout during first cold WebP encode, and (b) BaseHTTPMiddleware not tolerating client disconnects; both flagged as minor.
